_comment: External vulnerability feed for qphpscanner. Load with --vuln-feed <file-or-url> (repeatable). Entries are MERGED on top of the built-in catalogue; EOL dates override by branch. A version matches an entry when ANY of its 'affected' ranges match. Within a range, every populated bound must hold: 'branch' pins a major.minor; 'introduced' is an inclusive lower bound; 'fixed'/'lt' are exclusive upper bounds.
